slots.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

slots.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.
